title: Configuration and Installation Guide — EGOS Data Dissemination System
organisation: European Space Agency, Directorate of Operations and Infrastructure, OPS-GI (ESOC); prepared by the EDDS Team
status_notes: Title page: Version 25.0, 2025-03-07, 'Issue for EDDS v3.6.1i1' (Document Change Log, PDF p. 3). Page footers still read 'ISSUE:24.0 2025-01-10' (and 'ISSUE: 25.0 2024-03-08' on PDF p. 2). Latest CIG issue in the library; it supersedes cig-i14r0.
summary:
This is issue 25.0 (2025) of the **EDDS Configuration and Installation Guide**, covering release v3.6.1 of the [EGOS Data Dissemination System](../scos2000/edds.md). It keeps the structure of the 2018 issue (library item cig-i14r0) but documents the modernised platform and the integration with the European Ground Systems Common Core ([EGS-CC](../scos2000/ancillary-and-egs-cc.md)).

Section 3 describes prerequisites (SLES 15, OpenJDK/JRE 11, Tomcat 9, MariaDB, ActiveMQ, OpenLDAP, Pure-FTPd), the build and the large `edds-deploy.properties` table, and deploying the Archiver, Delivery Manager, Web Service, MMI, EDDS Server and optional tools. The property tables now include EGS-CC settings: a REST data-access endpoint, an HTTP or Kafka retrieval mode and a batch size. They also add `Egscc*` request types (parameters, parameter definitions, TM and TC packet reports, raw TM, activity reports) next to the classic SCOS-2000 ones, and a list of data sources ('DARC', 'PARC', 'HARC').

Section 4 adds a short subsection on EGS-CC missions, which only need an EDDS domain named after the mission's dataspace in the HBase cluster. It keeps the SCOS-2000 mission configuration: server properties, enabling services, retrying failed requests, XSL transformations and the **MIB files** each domain must supply (`pid.dat`, `tpcf.dat`, command subsystem and host files, `MISCbase.ids`, `MISCcontext_SHARED.sta`, source-type and OBQ-status mappings). Appendix A explains how raw packet headers and PARC TC history records are decoded, and adds XML custom-field definitions for TC records obtained from the SCOS-2000 data provision service. A new Appendix L describes the GitLab DevOps pipeline and the per-mission configuration directories.

key_points.text: Issue 25.0 corresponds to EDDS v3.6.1i1; the change log runs from issue 1.0 (2010-05-28) to 25.0 (2025-03-07), with issues 15.0 to 24.0 covering EDDS v2.4.0 to v3.6.0.
The only DCR entry for this issue is EDDS-1396, upgrading Tomcat to 9.0.100.
Prerequisites: SLES 15 (baseline SLES15-064-ESOCL01-i3r1), OpenJDK 11 (11.0.20+9) for compilation and JRE 11 for running, plus Tomcat and MariaDB from the SLES 15 baseline.

edds.server.supported.batch.requests lists request types such as Param, ParamStatistics, ParamDefinition, PktTm, PktTc, PktEvRaw, PktTmRaw, PktTmGapReport, ArchiveFile, OolRecordReport and EGS-CC variants (EgsccParam, EgsccPktTm, EgsccPktTmRaw, EgsccActivityReport); edds.server.supported_data_sources takes 'DARC','PARC','HARC'.
Stream request types are ParamStream, PktTmStream, PktTcStream, PktEvStream and OolStream; edds.server.enable.egscc turns on the EGS-CC integration.
EGS-CC data are retrieved from a REST data-access endpoint (edds.egscc.rest.dataaccess.url) using HTTP or Kafka retrieval modes, with a default batch size of 5000.
EGS-CC missions need no mission-specific configuration beyond a domain named after the mission dataspace in the HBase cluster; their configuration files are under config/HARC.
As in earlier issues, pid.dat (SPID to APID) and tpcf.dat (TM packet descriptions) from each SCOS-2000 domain must be copied to the EDDS MIB location.

TC records from the SCOS-2000 data provision service are decoded with DataProvisionCustomField XML files whose FieldPath follows the CHIScommandRecord.idl structure, for example command.record.releaseInf.subsystemName.
TC_PKT_CMD_LEN_PAR_INFO is 3 for SCOS-2000 6.2.0 and later and 2 for earlier versions.

Appendix L: EDDS DevOps pipelines run from the ESA GitLab project, and deployment is per mission, using a directory per mission under edds/edds-mission-config holding server and delivery-manager configuration.

One property-table cell reads 'EGSSC' (typo for EGSCC). The section 1.3 overview does not list Appendix L. Printed page numbers are PDF page minus 1. Later issue of the same document as cig-i14r0.
